```{=html}
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  function ensureQcTooltipEl() {
    var tip = document.getElementById("qc-instant-tooltip");
    if (!tip) {
      tip = document.createElement("div");
      tip.id = "qc-instant-tooltip";
      tip.className = "qc-instant-tooltip";
      document.body.appendChild(tip);
    }
    return tip;
  }

  function positionQcTooltip(tip, clientX, clientY) {
    var pad = 12;
    var rect = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
    var left = clientX + pad;
    var top = clientY + pad;
    if (left + rect.width > window.innerWidth - 8) {
      left = Math.max(8, clientX - rect.width - pad);
    }
    if (top + rect.height > window.innerHeight - 8) {
      top = Math.max(8, clientY - rect.height - pad);
    }
    tip.style.left = left + "px";
    tip.style.top = top + "px";
  }

  document.addEventListener("mouseover", function(e) {
    var badge = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".qc-badge") : null;
    if (!badge) return;
    var reason = badge.getAttribute("data-reason");
    if (!reason) return;
    var tip = ensureQcTooltipEl();
    tip.textContent = reason;
    tip.style.display = "block";
    positionQcTooltip(tip, e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });

  document.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e) {
    var badge = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".qc-badge") : null;
    var tip = document.getElementById("qc-instant-tooltip");
    if (!tip || tip.style.display !== "block") return;
    if (!badge) {
      tip.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }
    positionQcTooltip(tip, e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });

  document.addEventListener("mouseout", function(e) {
    var badge = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".qc-badge") : null;
    if (!badge) return;
    var toEl = e.relatedTarget;
    if (!toEl || !badge.contains(toEl)) {
      var tip = document.getElementById("qc-instant-tooltip");
      if (tip) tip.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
evaluate_hit_quality_df <- function(
  ident_pct,
  cov_pct,
  score_high = 0.8836,
  score_mid = 0.80,
  score_low = 0.71,
  cov_min = 80
) {
  n <- length(ident_pct)
  ident <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ident_pct))
  cov <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cov_pct))

  symbol <- rep("-", n)
  sym_class <- rep("", n)
  row_class <- rep("", n)
  reason <- rep("No numeric identity or coverage available.", n)

  valid <- !is.na(ident) & !is.na(cov)
  if (!any(valid)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      qc_symbol = symbol,
      qc_sym_class = sym_class,
      qc_row_class = row_class,
      qc_reason = reason
    ))
  }

  id_norm <- ident / 100
  cov_norm <- cov / 100
  score <- id_norm * cov_norm
  metrics_note <- sprintf(" (Identity: %.2f%%, Coverage: %.1f%%)", ident, cov)

  # 1. Coverage < 80% (regardless of identity) OR normalized score < 0.71 -> red cross
  is_red <- valid & (cov < cov_min | score < score_low)
  if (any(is_red)) {
    symbol[is_red] <- "\u2716"
    sym_class[is_red] <- "qc-symbol-red"
    row_class[is_red] <- "qc-row-red"
    reason[is_red] <- vapply(which(is_red), function(i) {
      parts <- character()
      if (cov[i] < cov_min) parts <- c(parts, sprintf("coverage is below %g%%", cov_min))
      if (score[i] < score_low) parts <- c(parts, sprintf("combined score is below %.2f", score_low))
      sprintf(
        "Not reliable and unsafe to interpret (%s)%s.",
        paste(parts, collapse = " and "),
        metrics_note[i]
      )
    }, character(1))
  }

  # 2. Score >= 0.8836 (and coverage >= 80%) -> green check mark
  is_green <- valid & !is_red & (score >= score_high)
  symbol[is_green] <- "\u2713"
  sym_class[is_green] <- "qc-symbol-green"
  reason[is_green] <- paste0("Prob. same species", metrics_note[is_green], ".")

  # 3. 0.80 <= Score < 0.8836 (and coverage >= 80%) -> yellow check mark
  is_yellow <- valid & !is_red & !is_green & (score >= score_mid)
  symbol[is_yellow] <- "\u2713"
  sym_class[is_yellow] <- "qc-symbol-yellow"
  reason[is_yellow] <- paste0("Prob. similar species (same genus)", metrics_note[is_yellow], ".")

  # 4. 0.71 <= Score < 0.80 (and coverage >= 80%) -> orange warning sign
  is_orange <- valid & !is_red & !is_green & !is_yellow
  symbol[is_orange] <- "\u26A0"
  sym_class[is_orange] <- "qc-symbol-orange"
  row_class[is_orange] <- "qc-row-orange"
  reason[is_orange] <- paste0("A bit too far, interpret with caution", metrics_note[is_orange], ".")

  tibble::tibble(
    qc_symbol = symbol,
    qc_sym_class = sym_class,
    qc_row_class = row_class,
    qc_reason = reason
  )
}

render_qc_badge_cell <- function(df_ref) {
  function(value, index, name) {
    sym <- if ("qc_symbol" %in% names(df_ref)) df_ref$qc_symbol[index] else "-"
    cls <- if ("qc_sym_class" %in% names(df_ref)) df_ref$qc_sym_class[index] else ""
    rsn <- if ("qc_reason" %in% names(df_ref)) df_ref$qc_reason[index] else ""

    htmltools::tags$span(
      class = trimws(paste("qc-badge qc-symbol", cls)),
      `data-reason` = rsn,
      sym
    )
  }
}

qc_row_class_fn <- function(df_ref) {
  function(index) {
    if ("qc_row_class" %in% names(df_ref)) df_ref$qc_row_class[index] else ""
  }
}
```
